capabilities: Export completed trips as Markdown notes
extras: Works with Obsidian Publish and Obsidian Mobile; data is stored locally in JSON/Markdown format.
problem: Standard note-taking apps lack a structured way to manage the three phases of a trip: planning, active travel documentation, and post-trip reflection/archiving.
summary: A private travel journal that allows users to plan itineraries, track travel in real-time, and export completed trips as searchable Markdown notes in their vault.
